title: Tikee — Selección de variables cuántico-inspirada para scoring crediticio
summary: A university research project (UTPL Ecuador) that formulates credit-scoring variable selection as a QUBO problem and compares quantum-inspired and classical solvers against LASSO/stepwise baselines on synthetic credit data. The synthetic dataset is produced via a custom Gaussian copula seed expanded with SDV's GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer and TVAESynthesizer, and its fidelity is checked with sdmetrics' QualityReport, DiagnosticReport and NewRowSynthesis.
evidence: src/tikee/data/sdv_synthesizer.py:112-133 fits GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, CTGANSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer via sdv.single_table; fidelity.py imports sdmetrics QualityReport/DiagnosticReport
